invariants.name: Identical-Input Identity
invariants.statement: If all n client update vectors are identical (u_1 = u_2 = ... = u_n = v), any robust aggregator AGG({u_i}) MUST return v.

invariants.name: Permutation Invariance
invariants.statement: For any permutation \pi of [n], AGG({u_{\pi(i)}}) = AGG({u_i}). Under exact distance or score ties, secondary tie-breaking MUST be content-deterministic rather than index-dependent.

invariants.name: Non-Finite Rejection & Sanitization
invariants.statement: No candidate update containing NaN, +Inf, or -Inf may be selected or used to corrupt the aggregate model. Non-finite values MUST fail closed or trigger immediate quarantine.

invariants.name: Precondition Enactment & Non-Degradation
invariants.statement: Aggregators must strictly enforce their mathematical preconditions (n >= 2f + 3 for Krum, n >= 4f + 3 for Bulyan, 2k < n for Trimmed Mean). Benchmarks fail loudly with InvalidConfigurationError; runtime services log structured warnings and execute certified fallbacks.

invariants.name: Honest Update Locality & Immutability
invariants.statement: Attacker updates are generated as new arrays or tensors. Honest bank local weights and model deltas MUST NEVER be modified in-place or mutated by attack generators.

invariants.name: Hardware Isolation Memory Boundary Preservation
invariants.statement: When TEE hardware isolation is enabled, robust aggregation on plaintext client parameters is executed exclusively within the enclave address space, preserving zero-leakage boundaries against untrusted host inspection.
